item.title: Outrageous: Slovakia criminalises questioning of Beneš decrees, i.e. WWII-era collective punishment of Hungarians
item.description: Slovakia’s president has signed a law making it a criminal offence to question the post-war Beneš decrees — a move that has sparked outrage among Hungarian minority groups and political figures in both Slovakia and Hungary.
